news.headline: Closing Arguments Wrap in Nektar v. Eli Lilly Trial as Jury Begins Deliberating $1 Billion Claim
news.summary: In closing arguments, Nektar's counsel told the California federal jury that Eli Lilly turned rezpegaldesleukin into 'damaged goods' by breaching the companies' co-development deal and favoring a competing drug it later acquired. The jury has now begun deliberations, with no verdict reached as of September 19, 2026.

news.headline: Lilly Executive Tells Jury Nektar Was 'Desperate' to Develop Rezpeg
news.summary: An Eli Lilly executive testified that his handwritten notes describing Nektar as 'desperate' referred to the company's need for rezpegaldesleukin to succeed, part of Lilly's defense in the ongoing breach-of-contract trial. Testimony continues to shape the jury's view ahead of a verdict on roughly $1 billion in claimed damages.

news.headline: Damages Expert Testifies Lilly Could Owe Nektar Nearly $1 Billion Over Rezpeg Deal
news.summary: Nektar's damages expert told the jury that Eli Lilly could owe the company close to $1 billion if found to have breached the license agreement to co-develop rezpegaldesleukin. The testimony underscored the scale of the binary financial outcome now facing the jury.

news.headline: Nektar Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA 24-Week Off-Treatment Alopecia Data
news.summary: Nektar announced it has entered a quiet period, consistent with its practice ahead of prior REZOLVE data disclosures, signaling that topline results from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up of its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study are approaching. This durability read-out is considered the next major pipeline catalyst after the on-treatment data already reported.

news.headline: Eli Lilly 'Sabotaged' Rezpeg's Development, Nektar Tells Jury as Trial Opens
news.summary: In opening statements of the long-delayed breach-of-contract trial, Nektar's lawyers accused Eli Lilly of sabotaging rezpegaldesleukin's development to favor its own competing eczema drug, while Lilly countered that Nektar suffered no real harm from the deal's termination. The trial, originally set for October 2025, finally got underway in the Northern District of California.

news.headline: Nektar Reports Q2 2026 Results, Cash Tops $1 Billion With Runway Into Q3 2028
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a narrower net loss, with cash and investments of roughly $1.02 billion after a $350 million offering, extending runway into Q3 2028 and through initial Phase 3 ZENITH AD data. Several analysts (including BTIG and HC Wainwright) raised price targets afterward, pushing the consensus target to around $153.

catalysts.label: Verdict in Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract trial
catalysts.detail: Closing arguments concluded September 18, 2026 in the Northern District of California; the jury is now deliberating on Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract claim over the failed rezpegaldesleukin co-development deal. A verdict could arrive any day and represents the most immediate binary event for the stock.

catalysts.when: Coming weeks to months (company in quiet period since Sept 8, 2026)
catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata data
catalysts.detail: Topline durability data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period, testing whether alopecia areata responses persist after stopping rezpegaldesleukin. This is the next major pipeline catalyst following prior positive on-treatment and 52-week extension results.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 ZENITH AD (atopic dermatitis) initial data
catalysts.detail: The registrational ZENITH AD Phase 3 program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis was initiated in July 2026; initial readouts are the key long-term value driver funded by the company's ~$1 billion cash position (runway into Q3 2028).

catalysts.label: Phase 3 registrational study initiation in alopecia areata
catalysts.detail: Following FDA alignment, Nektar finalized the design of a single registrational Phase 3 study for rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata, planned to begin enrolling in early 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on Nektar's recent quarterly cadence (Q2 2026 results were released August 13, 2026), Q3 2026 financial results and a pipeline/legal update are expected in mid-November 2026.

pulse: NKTR trades in the roughly $68-75 range after a strong 2026 rally, with the stock's near-term direction dominated by the Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract trial: closing arguments concluded September 18, 2026 with about $1 billion in damages at stake, and as of September 19 the jury is still deliberating with no verdict yet. Separately, Nektar has been in a quiet period since September 8, 2026 ahead of the pivotal 24-week off-treatment REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata data, which has not yet been reported. Fundamentals remain solid — Q2 2026 results showed roughly $1 billion in cash with runway into Q3 2028 and Phase 3 ZENITH AD underway — and several analysts raised price targets after earnings, but the stock remains highly volatile pending these two binary catalysts.
